audit.whatIsWrong: Sides read Cassiopeia / Skill x5 / Cassiopeia while every why-line under them says Cassiopeia owns levels 2 through first item and Volibear only takes the two-item row.
audit.why: packet levelChart is Skill / Cassiopeia x5 / Volibear, matching the prose exactly. The rendered sides matched nothing.
audit.corrected: All seven rows aligned to the packet as matched full/content pairs, ratings rebuilt, and every phases[].why rewritten so the explanation now supports the side it sits under.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown appeared in the lane text, and the spikes were built on item names rather than timings.
audit.why: Her tempo is defined by cooldowns: Noxious Blast 3.5s, Twin Fang 0.75s, Miasma 24/22/20/18/16s, Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Those four numbers plus Volibear's 300-range Thundering Smash written into early, mid, late, the spikes and the phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry claimed six times that Miasma's grounding shuts off Volibear's 'Q-flip dash'. Thundering Smash is not a dash.
audit.why: Riot's text gives Thundering Smash movement SPEED toward enemies and a stun on the first enemy he attacks — grounding disables Movement abilities, and the only one Volibear owns is Stormbringer's leap. The advice was inverted: you can walk into Miasma and still stun, but you cannot leap out of it. Second interaction never stated: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies FACING her; anyone with their back turned is slowed instead. Third: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of the damage it deals, so anti-heal matters against her E, not her R.
audit.corrected: Restated across spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2], early, mid, late, whys[2], wants.you[1], wants.foe[1], wants.foe[2] and phases[1-6].why.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Cassiopeia has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Level 2 is hers — Noxious Blast is up every 3.5s at 850 range and your stun only reaches 300. You cannot trade back.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Cassiopeia under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Twin Fang fires every 0.75s into anything poisoned and heals her off it. Sky Splitter's slow is your only reach until you close.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Cassiopeia down every time Miasma is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: She permakites 4-5: Serpentine Grace makes every move-speed source better on her, so she stays outside your 300-range stun.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Cassiopeia under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze (120s) stuns only enemies FACING her — turn away as she casts and you eat a slow instead, then Stormbringer in.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Cassiopeia to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Her first item extends the kite. Miasma (24s at rank 1) grounds, so it denies Stormbringer's leap, not your Thundering Smash.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Cassiopeia can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: Two items in you can finally cross the poison: health and MR let you eat a full rotation, and Frenzied Maul's second bite on the mark heals it back.

edits.before: Level 3 stays hers with E spam and W grounding your flip.
edits.after: Level 3 stays hers: Twin Fang re-fires every 0.75s.

edits.before: Cassiopeia's Q and W poison zone kite you the whole lane; her E spam chunks you and her W grounds your Q-flip dash, so you can't engage cleanly pre-6.
edits.after: Noxious Blast (3.5s, 850 range) outranges everything you have, and Twin Fang re-fires every 0.75s into the poison — you cannot trade back pre-6.

edits.before: Her R can face-stun you mid-engage and her W ground shuts off your flip — don't all-in unless her W is down, or she kites you to death.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze (120s) stuns only what faces her, and Miasma's grounding denies Stormbringer's leap — not Thundering Smash, which is no dash.

edits.before: Her Malignance/Rylai spike lets her permakite; the W ground plus Rylai slow keeps you out of range while her E finishes you off.
edits.after: Her first item lets her permakite; Miasma's slow plus Serpentine Grace's move-speed bonus keeps her outside your 300-range stun.

edits.before: Level 1 is even, but from 2 on Cassiopeia takes the lane. Her Q and W poison zone kite you, her E spam chunks you, and crucially her W grounds your Q-flip so you can't engage. Farm carefully and don't walk into her poison.
edits.after: Level 1 is even, but from 2 on Cassiopeia takes the lane. Noxious Blast is up every 3.5s at 850 range and Twin Fang re-fires every 0.75s into anything poisoned, healing her. Farm carefully and stay out of the clouds.

edits.before: This is her whole game. Through 6 she permakites — W grounds your dash, her R can face-stun you mid-commit, and her E finishes low targets. Only all-in when her W is on cooldown; otherwise you die walking at her.
edits.after: This is her whole game. Through 6 she permakites, and Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing her — turn your back as she casts and you take the slow. Miasma (24s at rank 1) grounds Stormbringer, so save the leap.

edits.before: You claw it back only by out-scaling. Buy MR early, look for flank angles, and stack enough HP to survive her R stun and burst. In a straight lane she out-poisons you all game, so respect her until your items let you eat a full combo and still reach her.
edits.after: You claw it back only by outscaling. Buy MR early and stack enough health to survive Petrifying Gaze plus a full poison rotation — then Thundering Smash closes and Frenzied Maul's second bite on the mark heals the poison back off you.

edits.before: Bait her W ground before committing your Q flip
edits.after: Bait Miasma before you commit Stormbringer

edits.before: Ground your Q dash with W to deny engage
edits.after: Ground your Stormbringer leap with Miasma

edits.before: Face-stun you with R when you finally close in
edits.after: Stun you with Petrifying Gaze as you close in

notes: The packet itself flags the contradiction: Volibear wins 52.59% over 348 games, yet the chart gives Cassiopeia five of seven stages. I made the page self-consistent by aligning the sides to the packet chart and the existing prose rather than inventing a new reading, but the win rate and the chart still disagree — flagged in questionsForUser. Executioner's Calling is worth more than the report suggests here: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of its damage on a 0.75s cooldown.
